tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// a rog ches 'bum bzhengs pa'i rab byed bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// srid zhi'i bde legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// rgyal sras rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// dus gsum rgyal ba skyed par byed pa'i yum// shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu lam rnam pa'i rang bzhin skye med par// bsgom pa goms shing sbyor ba rnam bzhi yi// phrin las bcas pa'i chos sku legs brnyed pa// bde gshegs skyob pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yi ge'i ming tshig sna tshogs sbyor ba yi// brjod pas brjod du med pa'i don ston zhing*// zab cing spros bral ngang du zhi byed pa// chags bral dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bgrod pa gcig lam chos la zhugs gyur zhing*// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i go bgos nas// kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor nyer gzhol ba// rgyal sras dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid gyur pa// gang las dkon mchog gsum dge gsum 'byung zhing*// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya bdun pa'i tshe// rang gis sngon dge spyad pa'i 'bras smin pas// hor gyi rigs kyi gtso bor nyer bskrun zhing*// blo dang mthu stobs phun sum tshogs gyur pas// 'dzam gling byang phyogs srid la dbang gyur pa'i// rgyal po'i mchog gyur de ni jing gir gan// de yis lo grangs sum cu lhag pa ru// rgyal srid bskyangs nas de sras mchog gyur pa// ga gan rgyal pos rgyal thabs ring du mdzad// de sras go yug gan zhes bya bas kyang*// rgyal srid gtso bo rnam par thob par gyur// de yi yab mched mo go gan zhes bya// rgyal srid bzung nas de rjes de yi gcung*// go pe la zhes mtshan du rab grags pa// dad dang shes rab brtse ba'i ngang tshul can// bden pa'i stobs kyis sa chen skyong ba yi// rgyal chen nyid gyur btsun mo'i mchog gyur pa// cha'u ga dun zhes grags zung gi sras// jim gyim maṅga la dang no mo gan// de dag gi gcung a rog che zhes pas// yab dang gcen gyi dri lan bsabs phyir dang*// rang gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir// rgya bod sa mtshams shing kun zhes bya bar// shing pho khyi lo'i ston zla rnam gsum la// dge slong da rig zhes byas gtsor byas pa'i// yig mkhan rnams dang gzhan yang bzo rig la// mkhas pa shin tu mang po nyer bsdus nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyin// stong phrag brgya pa gser gyi rang bzhin las// nye bar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog

/gnas skabs rgyal po mchog dang gcen rnams dang*// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// rtag tu dam chos tshul bzhin spyod par shog /shing pho khyi'i lo ston zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la bris pa'i yi ge'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
